lines: Phool shabnam mein doob jaate hain
couplets.en: Flowers drown in dew.

lines: Zakhm marham mein doob jaate hain

lines: Jab koi aasra nahin milta

lines: Gham tere gham mein doob jaate hain

lines: Tum poochho aur main na bataaun
